commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

connectionId.description: A key-manager connection's id: a version 4 UUID the adding client mints, kept in lowercase.

kind.description: What holds a stored value Move can take: forge-account (a forge account's pasted token).

id.description: The item's id with its owner: a forge account's id.

items.description: An item Move takes, by its kind and its owner's id for it.
The items to move, or all: every item holding a stored value when the Move begins.

overwrite.description: Replace a different value already at a target; absent or false refuses it conflict reason target_exists.

verifyOnly.description: Write nothing: read back what a person pasted at each target, compare it with the stored value, and swap and delete as a Move does. A different value there is conflict reason read_back_differs, and none reference_not_found, each leaving the item as it was.
